text_block_list.text:
One day, Hishi Amazon was practicing dance 
lessons alone, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it's really lacking something. It 
needs more of a punch, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If it's running training, we could go 
head-to-head in a match race, but... hm? 
Wait a sec.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ain't nothin' saying we can't settle this 
with a dance battle, right?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you thought dance lessons would 
be more efficient with two people, just 
like running in tandem?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, Fuji's great at dancing, right? 
She's more than worthy as an opponent for 
a one-on-one!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's just what I want. It's a 
once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for me as 
well, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaah! Fuji-senpaaaai!! Do your beeeest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, who the heck are they!? Fuji, did 
you call them over!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I just thought our match would be so 
much more exciting with an audience, don't 
you think?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you thought we were just 
going to take it easy and play nice just 
because it's dance?

Seeing Fuji Kiseki give a subtle wink, I 
knew she was genuinely willing to help.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Bring it on! Enjoy that smug 
confidence while you still can!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's our Hishi Ama! Inviting them was 
definitely worth it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, no way I'm gonna lose! Keep your 
eyes on me, Trainy!
choice_data_list: If you give it your all, you can win!
Let's stay cool and calm here!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Naturally! I'm gonna blow away Fuji 
and the crowd with my momentum!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the fire's been lit in your 
heart. But on stage, I won't be outdone by 
you either!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how's that?! Now you've felt my 
full power...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Not bad at all. It was as if you were 
draped in flames.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-senpai's dancing has so much 
power...! But in terms of technique, 
Fuji-senpai is...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, looks like you've still got a long 
way to go. It's not a real victory unless 
you leave everyone in awe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, true enough. I'll keep honing myself 
too. Enough to surpass your absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Next time, I'm definitely gonna win!

And so, Hishi Amazon polished not just her 
running, but also her dancing skills.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Our opponent is Fuji. Times like 
this are when we gotta keep our cool!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"As expected, having her Trainer by her 
side seems to have elevated Hishi Ama's 
power to another level."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you see that?! A dance that 
rivals even Fuji-senpai's...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Dancing on par with Fuji,’ huh? In other 
words, it's a draw."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but Hishi Ama, I really can't take my 
eyes off you even more now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to lose in dancing or 
racing. As an entertainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, so even cool-headed Fuji got all 
fired up, huh? Now that's a treat!

And so, by pushing each other to excel 
with her rival, Hishi Amazon improved her 
dancing.
